schema.name: idx_audit_run
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_run ON audit_events(run_id, id)

schema.name: idx_tx_account
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tx_account ON ledger_transactions(from_account, to_account)

schema.name: audit_events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            ts TEXT NOT NULL,
            actor TEXT NOT NULL,
            action TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
            detail_json TEXT NOT NULL
        )

schema.name: ledger_accounts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger_accounts (
            account_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            owner TEXT NOT NULL,
            balance REAL NOT NULL,
            currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD'
        )

schema.name: ledger_meta
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger_meta (
            key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            value INTEGER NOT NULL
        )

schema.name: ledger_transactions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE ledger_transactions (
            seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            tx_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            from_account TEXT NOT NULL,
            to_account TEXT NOT NULL,
            amount REAL NOT NULL,
            currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD'
        )

schema.name: runs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runs (
            run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            status TEXT NOT NULL,
            version INTEGER NOT NULL,
            run_json TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        )

schema.name: schema_migrations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
            version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
        )
